conflicting_duplicate_resolution: For each conflicting Date-Country key, use the rounded median of duplicate Arrivals values. The raw conflicting rows remain in artifacts/conflicting_duplicates.csv.
missing_panel_resolution: Missing country-month combinations are treated as zero arrivals because this source-style panel reports countries in observed rows and omits no-arrival countries. This is a modeling assumption that can be revised if SLTDA row inclusion rules are confirmed.
